claim: The CloudFront FAQ lists exceptions for Anycast Static IPs; among them, Anycast Static IPs will not support legacy clients that cannot support SNI, and you are required to use Price Class All when using Anycast Static IPs.
note: mine-15-faq; register-15: the FAQ's third exception ('You must disable IPv6') is out of date: Anycast static IPs support dual-stack since 2025-11-05 (cloudfront-change-anycast-ipv6-2025-11); the claim leaves it out adjudicate-15: the FAQ's third exception (disable IPv6) is outdated since dual-stack Anycast static IPs (cloudfront-change-anycast-ipv6-2025-11); the claim names only the two exceptions that the guide still supports.
